source_scope.encoding: UTF-8 with BOM; CRLF source line endings

line_representation.leaf: one TEI source-line seg per decoded source line, with source heading lines as head leaves
line_representation.identity: source line number, byte span, raw-line SHA-256, and exact visible text
line_representation.formatting: Exact source delimiters remain readable; source-supported typography receives native hi spans with source coordinates. Cross-line and split spans resolve to a real first-fragment ID. No normalization or inferred verse joins.

range_continuation_example.rule: retain page-context carrier; do not infer a joined verse unit

mapping.range_occurrence: source range heading plus source-native scripture, optional paraphrase, lemma annotation, critical apparatus band, and commentary spans until the next heading or region end
mapping.paragraph: contiguous nonblank source lines become TEI p blocks with exact source-line seg leaves
mapping.heading: source-located display headings and range heads become native TEI head source-line leaves; footnote markers use native note label leaves because the bundled P5 content model does not allow note/head
mapping.footnote: Footnote N becomes a native TEI note with a label source-line leaf and indented body p blocks, excluding trailing blank lines
mapping.sidenote: literal [Sidenote: ...] spans, including source line continuation segments
mapping.apparatus: critical Greek reading bands remain distinct apparatus child units; Various Readings, Laodiceans manuscript/capitula, Laodiceans text/apparatus, and notes/history are separate source regions
mapping.lemma: source-separated Greek lemma plus gloss/annotation spans remain distinct lemma child units
mapping.parallel_reading: the source's prose wrapper contains two provisional source-linear native TEI tables: lines 18466-18474 and 18481-18485, with blank source lines retained in one ordered cell per source row; page-image column geometry remains unresolved
mapping.footnote_reference: All 761 genuine source calls link to the unique retained Footnote definition. The year [1550] at line3804 and scripture verse [24] at line18346 remain literal. Actual reference text and character offsets must match the source.
mapping.mixed_source_line: line 13183 is retained as one source line with exact inline parts: the Greek prefix is marked scripture-text and the English suffix commentary; no verse join is inferred
mapping.index_and_license: retained as envelope regions with exact source-line leaves
mapping.typography: Independent source interval coverage governs underscore italics and Greek emphasis, double-equals uncial, the explicit blackletter example, generic equals emphasis, superscript and subscript notation. Literal exceptions remain source-located. Actual hi intervals and links are checked before a private clone is normalized for structural checks. Per-line parts[].id values identify source-only intervals, not necessarily XML elements; actual fragments may subdivide them. Each whole span ID resolves to a real first XML fragment.

limitations: Greek/paraphrase/lemma/apparatus/commentary labels are source-layout carriers established by bounded lexical/layout rules and source-located exceptions; they remain open to human review.
Repeated range labels are not deduplicated and no semantic verse joins are inferred.
The two parallel-reading tables preserve source order and blank lines in provisional one-cell rows; original page-image columns have not been established.
The mixed source line at 13183 is split only at the exact retained Greek/English boundary and remains a source-layout interpretation pending human review.
The candidate does not establish rights, human textual acceptance, visual source comparison, or publication authorization.

Two numeric brackets remain source-located literals: year [1550] at line3804 and scripture verse [24] at line18346; all other numeric bracket calls are source-resolved and checked at exact character offsets.
The three mixed-script underscore spans and two generic equals-emphasis spans preserve emphasis while their exact printed font remains unresolved.
